notes: NorthRay Capture 0.10.0: the overlay designer, with templates for Starting Soon, Be Right Back, Ending, lower thirds, facecam frames and panels.
NorthRay Launcher now holds NorthRay's own apps only. CJ Philip Community (with CJ Radio) is a separate launcher, downloaded from the NorthRay Software website, and keeps itself up to date.

Today, on the home page: your words today, your goal and your writing streak from NorthRay Writing Studio, and your newest screenshots and pictures saved by NorthRay Capture. Switch it off in Settings if you'd rather not see it.
An app's page shows how much space it takes on disk.
Fixed: a long description on an app's card no longer runs into its version line.
NorthRay Capture 0.9.4: optional audio-effect plugins, off until you switch each one on.
NorthRay Capture 0.9.3: camera borders go round the outside of the picture.
NorthRay Capture 0.9.2: a Camera Border maker (rounded corners or a circle, rings, glows and shadows, live, and PNG export).
NorthRay Capture 0.9.1: a different audio mix for each stream destination, a second audio output, and routing presets.
NorthRay Capture 0.9.0: audio filters for every sound source (noise gate, noise suppression, compressor, limiter, equaliser and more).
NorthRay Capture 0.8.3: video and sound files, stinger and custom shader transitions, and groups.
NorthRay Capture 0.8.2: scene folders, and exporting and importing scenes.
NorthRay Capture 0.8.1: image (including animated GIF), text, colour, slideshow and screen-region sources; exact position, rotation and opacity.
NorthRay Capture 0.8.0: transitions (fade, slide, swipe, luma wipe), Studio Mode, and scenes inside scenes.
NorthRay Capture 0.7.0: multistreaming to up to six destinations at once, sharing one encode where they can (new, and not yet tried with a real platform).
NorthRay Capture 0.6.1: signing in to Twitch and YouTube to get the stream key automatically (switched on once NorthRay's app registrations are in place).

NorthRay Capture 0.6.0: streaming to Twitch, YouTube, Kick or a custom RTMP/RTMPS server, with the key in Windows Credential Manager and automatic reconnection (new, and not yet tried with a real platform).
NorthRay Capture 0.5.0: recording to MKV with hardware H.264 and up to six audio tracks (new, and not yet tried on real hardware), and a sync test source.
NorthRay Capture 0.4.0: audio routing (stream, six recording tracks, monitor), monitoring in your headphones, and warnings when sound kept off the stream would still reach it.
NorthRay Capture 0.3.0: sound capture (microphones, desktop audio and, on Windows 11, one program's sound on its own) with an audio mixer. Recording and streaming are still to come.
NorthRay Capture 0.2.0: captures displays, windows and cameras into a live preview, where you can move, resize, crop and rotate them. Sound, recording and streaming are still to come.
New in the Launcher: NorthRay Capture 0.1.0, livestreaming and recording, in early development. This first version is the workspace and scenes only: it doesn't capture, record or stream yet.
Every NorthRay app: buttons in question boxes respond to clicks again when Windows' display scaling is above 100% (Writing Studio 0.34.2, Files 0.6.1, Browser 0.8.1).
Writing Studio 0.34.2: Review's “Change to” changes names next to curly quotes, possessives and dashes too.
NorthRay Files 0.6.0: the Recycle Bin inside Files, and drag and drop with other programs.
NorthRay Browser 0.8.0: back up and restore your bookmarks, reference boards, notes, settings and history in one file.
NorthRay Files 0.5.0: colour labels, tags, collections and a gallery view.
NorthRay Files 0.4.1: a preview pane, and pictures of Photoshop, Procreate and Krita files.
NorthRay Files 0.4.0: search as you type, in a folder or across the whole PC.
Writing Studio 0.34.1: search and scroll when choosing who a relationship is with.
NorthRay Files 0.3.0: tabs, two panes side by side, drag and drop, pinned folders and a folder tree.
NorthRay Files 0.2.0: copy, move, rename, new folder and delete (to the Recycle Bin), Windows' own right-click menu, and folders that refresh themselves.

Writing Studio 0.34.0: the world bible is finished for now: maps with pins, checks, a glossary with pronunciation, magic and powers, spoilers, and sharing as a website, a printable bible or a reader's guide; names offered and added as you write.
Writing Studio 0.33.0: family trees from the bible's relationships.
NorthRay Browser 0.7.2: the video pop-out keeps the video's shape, with back 10 s, play or pause, forward 10 s, and Skip ad.
Writing Studio 0.32.1: Race lists only the races you've made, with “New race…”.
NorthRay Browser 0.7.1: the video pop-out shows just the video, with its bar only while the mouse is over it.
Writing Studio 0.32.0: entry pages with sections from a template you can change, notes per book, a gallery and image boards inside each entry.
NorthRay Browser 0.7.0: pop out a video to watch it on top of other apps, and it keeps going when an advert ends.
Writing Studio 0.31.0: the world bible tidies its copies and kinds, and creatures are browsed species › kind › named ones.
NorthRay Browser 0.6.0: a start page with your own picture, a clock, notes and the weather, and an offer to be the default browser.
NorthRay Browser 0.5.0: reference boards for pictures saved from pages, and a colour picker.
Writing Studio 0.30.0: the cover designer makes print covers too (back, spine and front, as a print-ready PDF), and it's easier to find.
NorthRay Browser 0.4.0: a Downloads page and blocking of ads and trackers, with Google as the default search engine.
Writing Studio 0.29.0: an ebook cover designer, and EPUBs styled like the printed book with the book's typeface inside.
Messages and questions (“Delete this?”, “Saved”) now appear in a NorthRay dialog that matches the app, instead of the plain grey Windows box.
Writing Studio 0.28.0: review copies for beta readers, Ctrl+Backspace word deletion, a Fit page width, and apostrophe words in the dictionary.
Text on the night sky stays clear: stars keep away from the words in title bars and sidebars.

The Writing Studio's new icon.
The small text links are now proper buttons.
Links look cleaner: no underlines, a soft highlight when you point at them.
The stars in the night sky twinkle softly (still when Windows' animations are turned off).

Fixed: a button that opens a dialog or menu could, rarely, act on the wrong thing.
Maintenance release.
No more status bar along the bottom of the window. Messages appear for a moment as a small note near the bottom instead. When updates were last checked is on the Updates page.
Maintenance release.

Minimise, maximise and close are now part of the app's own top area, like NorthRay Browser, instead of a separate Windows title bar. Drag the empty part of the top to move the window; double-click it to maximise. On Windows 11, pointing at maximise shows the snap layouts.
Updates now install automatically, on by default: after each check, every few hours, and never while an app is open (its update waits until you close it). You can turn this off in Settings.
NorthRay Launcher can keep running in the notification area when you close its window, so updates still install. Its icon there opens your apps and quits the launcher.
New setting: Start with Windows (off by default). It starts quietly in the notification area, with no window.
A short three-step welcome tour the first time you open it: what it is, where apps go, and updates.
Bigger app cards in the Library. CJ Philip's apps now have their own Optional section at the bottom.
The setup closes a running launcher by itself, and uninstalling removes it from Windows start-up.
Lists NorthRay Files, an early preview of NorthRay's file manager, to install and update like the other apps.
Lists NorthRay Browser, an early preview of NorthRay's web browser, to install and update like the other apps.
Release candidate for version 1.0.
A new look: the sidebar and banners are a night sky lit by the aurora.
The Library opens with a banner showing what's installed and ready to update, and a "What's new" row with the latest notes from each app.
App pages have screenshots. Click one to see it full-size, and use the arrow keys or the buttons to go through them.
A short welcome the first time the Launcher opens: choose where apps are installed and whether updates install by themselves.
CJ Philip Community is marked as an optional download.
Settings and the saved catalogue are read more carefully, and an unrecoverable error now shows a message with a saved report.
CJ Radio is no longer listed here: it's installed, updated and opened from CJ Philip Community, which NorthRay Launcher still installs.

No scroll bars: the faint bar that showed while scrolling is gone too.
Smoother animations: eased page changes, status messages that fade in and out, and softer hover effects.
Download progress bars glide smoothly, and app rows lift on hover.
Reads the app catalogue from the NorthRay website.

NorthRay Launcher replaces the CJ Community launcher as the central app manager.
Downloads apps over HTTPS with a progress bar, checks each installer's size and SHA-256, then installs it silently.
